description: This is a Java test class for the ExternalEventConfigurationValidationService, containing unit tests that verify configuration validation logic based on tenant data and external event settings.

classes.name: ExternalEventConfigurationValidationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ExternalEventConfigurationValidationService, testing scenarios for successful validation, missing configurations, and no configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test by instantiating the service under test.

methods.name: givenAllConfigurationWhenValidatedThenValidationSuccessful
